name: Web4 Global
description: Web4 Global is the global community of developers building for Web 4: chapters in cities, build nights, a builder track and answers, all run as an accountable organisation on the FlashyOS mesh.

knowsAbout.name: financial layer of the agentic internet

roles.name: steward
roles.purpose: Approves chapter charters and changes to the code of conduct. Nothing joins the chapter list without a person's yes, and the steward is where every other role escalates.

roles.name: integrity
roles.purpose: Enforces the code of conduct and the consent rule on member data. Refuses rather than warns, and a refusal leaves a record.

roles.name: chapters
roles.purpose: Onboards a chapter through the kit and keeps each one at conformance level two on its own domain. A chapter that stops serving its charter drops out of the list without anyone being asked.

roles.name: programs
roles.purpose: Runs build nights, the builder track and hackathons, each with a stated outcome and a witnessed observance on the calendar.

roles.name: answers
roles.purpose: Publishes answers and glossary pages that cite each term's owner and never restate a definition another property owns.

roles.name: partnerships
roles.purpose: Brings sponsors and enterprise chapters in on written terms. A sponsorship is announced only after its terms are signed.

roles.name: members
roles.purpose: Helps a new member reach a first contribution. Holds no member data beyond what the directory publishes by the member's own assertion.

roles.name: measurement
roles.purpose: Runs the chapter survey and publishes the tally. Unread is never zero: a chapter that could not be fetched is reported by name and enters no ratio.

answers.question: What is a Web 4 developer?
answers.definition: A Web 4 developer builds software that lets agents discover, identify, authorize, trust, transact with and audit one another across organisations, on open protocols, with a human accountable for every agent they ship.

answers.question: What is an agentic developer?
answers.definition: An agentic developer is a developer whose primary users are software agents: they publish machine-readable surfaces, declare what their agents may do, and build so that another organisation's agent can verify every claim without asking.

answers.question: What is a Web 4 community?
answers.definition: A Web 4 community is a group of developers who build for Web 4 together in public: in chapters with a named lead, at build nights that are recorded, and as an organisation whose agents and rules strangers can read.

answers.question: What is Web4 Global?
answers.definition: Web4 Global is the global community of agentic developers: city chapters, build nights, a builder track and answers, run as an accountable organisation on the FlashyOS mesh with a public charter, directory and calendar.

answers.question: What is a Web 4 chapter?
answers.definition: A Web 4 chapter is a city-based group of agentic developers that is itself an organisation on the mesh: its own domain, charter and accountable lead, a consented membership edge to Web4 Global, and a monthly witnessed build night.

answers.question: How do I build on Web 4?
answers.definition: Pick the layer of the stack your work answers, publish a handshake and a charter on your own domain, run the conformance check until it exits zero, and ship work that settles on the mesh with a re-verifiable record.

answers.question: How do I start a Web4 Global chapter?
answers.definition: Name a lead, pick a city and a monthly build night, run the chapter kit on a domain you control, reach conformance level two there, adopt the code of conduct, and file the membership edge for a steward to countersign.

answers.question: What is a build night?
answers.definition: A build night is a chapter’s monthly working session: developers ship something for Web 4 in one evening, the chapter’s agent records it with public evidence, a second party witnesses it, and the lead consecrates it.

answers.question: How does a developer reach conformance level two?
answers.definition: Serve a valid flashyos/1 handshake at /.well-known/flashyos.json and an AAO charter at /.well-known/flashyos-charter.json on your own domain that passes every static question, then run npx @flashyos/conformance with --level 2 against the live domain until it exits zero.

answers.question: What is a Web 4 hackathon?
answers.definition: A Web 4 hackathon is a build competition run through the mesh: intents are filed, work is offered and settled, and receipts are sealed, so the proof of what was built is a record, not a press release.
